a.lede: The cryptocurrency exchange said it's now covered 95% of the stolen assets.
a.title: Binance resumes withdrawals following $6.3 billion breach

b.lede: Binance withdrawals frozen after thieves run off with $5.6 billion in crypto — firm says it will cover losses as stablecoin networks move to freeze $2.4b in stolen assets
b.title: Suspected North Korean hackers steal $5.6 billion in crypto in record-breaking cryptocurrency heist, Binance withdrawals frozen
